messages:
ella: Quick heads-up — customer 'Atlas' reporting hallucinations (~2% of queries) after GA. I put sample traces in the ticket: https://redwood.atlas/INC-4567
ben: Ack. Do we have a reproducible prompt set? If so, low-risk approach is a targeted prompt-sanitization override for that tenant.
priya: I'll pull the evaluation harness and run the repro set. Need to quantify regen rate and which endpoints.
kevin: If it's config-only we can flip a router prompt override scoped to Atlas. No model swap needed, rolling canary should work.
ella: SLA note — Atlas expects <5m TTR for P1. Prefer quick config patch if it materially reduces hallucinations.
ben: Proposal: 1) staged prompt override for Atlas; 2) run 5k-sample eval; 3) if >1% still, schedule model-variant fallback.
priya: Starting eval now. ETA ~45m. Will log artifacts to /evals/postlaunch/atlas-2026-03-23.
kevin: I'll prepare a canary rollout plan: v0.3.1-hotfix -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Wire alarms for hallucination_rate and p95_latency.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: v0.3.1-hotfix -> 10% traffic. Watch metrics: customer-atlas.hallucination_rate, p95_latency, error_rate.
ella: If canary shows no latency regression and hallucination drops <0.5% we keep. Otherwise rollback and escalate to model swap with CS notice.
ben: Also: add telemetry tags on responses (prompt_hash, model_variant, tenant_id) so we can trace regressions per tenant.
priya: Eval finished: hallucination down from 2.1% -> 0.4% on the sample with prompt override. p95 latency +3ms. Uploading report now.
kevin: Canary at 10% looks stable for the last 10m; ramping to 50%. No spike in GPU queues or p99.
ella: Nice. Action items: priya -> upload eval artifacts + canonical failing prompts; ben -> add telemetry tag change to router; kevin -> continue rollout and abort if alarms fire; I'll update CS & the customer commit.
ben: +1 :thumbsup:
ella: We'll add a short CI regression test for the repro set next sprint so this doesn't regress unnoticed.
kevin: Filing the rollout notes in #eng-runtime and adding the canary link to the incident ticket.
ella: Thanks team — closing loop once customer confirmation received.
